title: Sommes d'exponentielles avec dérivée troisième monotone
notes: Acta Arithmetica 119 (2005), 1-11, Theorem 1. For C3 phases with |f'''| comparable to lambda, monotone f''', and length at least lambda^(-1), the sum is O(M*lambda^(1/6+1/1354)). Also stated as Theorem 8 in the author's 2016 survey. The inverse-cell application checks monotonicity after exact rational cubic removal and retains the length cost by C3 extension; the source theorem is not itself a Juggler statement.
